incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-gateway-eu1 · symptom=5xx_rate_spike · window=2m · value=13.8% · threshold=10% · runbook=/runbooks/inference/5xx-spike
pagerduty: Incident #PD-82341 triggered, paging rotation: oncall-sre-eu · link=https://pd.example/PD-82341
sanjay_sre: ACKED. I'm on it. Jumping into logs and traffic graph.
megan_pm: Noted. Any known deployments in the last 30m? Customers flagged chat endpoints.
alex_ops: seeing a deploy webhook at 2812345300 for model-proxy v1.13 -> maybe coincidence.
lisa_support: customer portal shows a surge of 502/504 errors starting ~2812345200, multiple customers reporting higher latency.
sanjay_sre: grabbing short stack traces. Running quick grep on gateway logs:
```
grep "502" /var/log/gateway/eu/*.log | tail -n 20
2026-03-14T22:45:21Z  gateway-eu1 req=abcd status=502 upstream=kvcache-02 err=read ECONNRESET
2026-03-14T22:45:22Z  gateway-eu1 req=abce status=502 upstream=model-enc-03 err=timeout
... (similar) ...
```
megan_pm: Any indications it's model-serving vs kvcache vs edge?
sanjay_sre: error mix: some ECONNRESET to kvcache and timeouts to encoders. Suggest dual-pronged mitigation: 1) reduce request fanout to encoders, 2) temporarily route traffic away from eu1 to eu2 for non-low-latency tiers.
alex_ops: I can open a routing policy to divert 25% of traffic away from eu1 for non-SLA clients. Will do if SRE ok.
sanjay_sre: do it. Also increasing encoder pool by +2 nodes (scale group sg-enc-eu) to handle backlog.
pagerduty: Escalation: No response from secondary oncall; escalating to SRE lead.
lisa_support: Logged customers A, C, and D as impacted; CS is sending status updates.
megan_pm: Please confirm whether feature flag "kv-prefetch" was toggled during deploy. That would explain kvcache pressure.
sanjay_sre: checking feature flag history...
```
curl -sS https://flags.internal/api?flag=kv-prefetch | jq .
{"flag":"kv-prefetch","status":"on","last_modified":"2026-03-14T22:30:12Z","by":"deploy-bot"}
```
alex_ops: yep flag was enabled in the deploy. Rolling it back now.
sanjay_sre: rollback issued: `flags unset kv-prefetch --env=eu` -> monitor logs
(30s)
alex_ops: flag unset confirmed. kvcache error rate dropping in metrics dashboard (5xx from kvcache down to baseline).
sanjay_sre: encoder timeouts still present but reduced. Scaling encoders: `asg scale sg-enc-eu +2` executed.
lisa_support: CS update sent: "We are aware of elevated errors; engineers are mitigating. Some requests may be slower or return errors for 10-15 minutes."
megan_pm: Good comms. Any need to open a customer-facing incident page?
lisa_support: not yet, CS will follow up if errors persist beyond next 30m.
incident-bot: Metrics: inference-gateway-eu1 5xx_rate: 13.8% -> 4.2% after mitigation within 6m.
sanjay_sre: traffic divert in place (25% to eu2), kv-prefetch rolled back, encoder pool scaled +2. Observability shows latency back to normal for most routes.
pagerduty: PD-82341 acknowledged and incident status: investigating -> mitigation applied.
megan_pm: Are there any retries or client-side patterns that might have amplified load?
sanjay_sre: trace sampling shows a cohort with aggressive retry on 502s; added short-lived rate-limit for that route to avoid self-amplification: `rl add route:/chat/v1 burst=100/s sustained=20/s duration=300s`.
alex_ops: applied. CPU and queue depth stabilizing.
lisa_support: CS confirms reduced incoming tickets.
megan_pm: Outline for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = feature flag kv-prefetch enabled during a deploy increased kvcache fanout and combined with a spike in fanout/retries led to connection resets and encoder timeouts; contributing factor = lack of deploy-time circuit breaker for kv-prefetch.
sanjay_sre: agree. Next actions: 1) add deploy gate to prevent enabling kv-prefetch without canary, 2) implement circuit breaker on kvcache (max outstanding per-client), 3) improve PD alert thresholds to include correlation across kvcache+encoder errors.
lisa_support: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and collect customer impact details for the PM & SE teams.
megan_pm: Handoff: I'm taking notes. Sanjay, will you hand off to day oncall?
sanjay_sre: Handoff to day-oncall @alex_ops in 20m. Current status = mitigated, monitoring. I'll post a short summary in #incidents and link runbook + actions.
alex_ops: acked, I'll watch for regression through morning.
incident-bot: PD incident PD-82341 resolved by sanjay_sre — resolution notes: rolled back kv-prefetch, scaled encoders, diverted non-SLA traffic.
sanjay_sre: short summary: mitigation successful; 5xx rate returned to baseline; customers notified; follow-ups scheduled (deploy gate, circuit breaker, alert tuning). Will start a postmortem doc and tag relevant owners. :white_check_mark:
megan_pm: Thanks all — great coordination.
lisa_support: leaving final ticket notes and customer list in the doc.
alex_ops: handing off monitoring to oncall-eu-day.
(meeting reaction) :thumbsup: \"
